name: Reading Group (imported without its material)
purpose: Shows what a council looks like after an import whose sources were left behind: the inventory is complete, the material is not, and every citation against it resolves to 'material not available' until someone supplies text that hashes to the recorded capture.

members.scope: Runs the round, reports where members disagree, and never adds a position of its own.
members.limitations: Has no grounding of its own; everything it reports must trace to a member contribution.

members.represents: T. Vance, author of the fictional reading notes this fixture stands in for
members.scope: How a group should treat a book it has only read once, as argued in one short set of notes.
members.limitations: The notes themselves did not travel with this council. Until the material is supplied, this member is an inventory entry: its citations resolve to 'material not available' and nothing it says can be checked against a source.

seats.responsibility: Synthesise the round and preserve disagreement.
Argue what a first reading can and cannot conclude.

sources.title: Notes on a first reading (fixture text)
sources.author: T. Vance

anchors.quote: What the group owes a book on a first reading is an honest account of what it has not yet understood.
